reports.verdict: CoreWeave beat on sales and lifted its 2026 outlook as its order backlog hit $132.5B, but a $709M quarterly loss and heavy debt remain the concern.

takeaways.label: Beat and raise
takeaways.text: Revenue was $3.66B, up about 168% from a year ago, versus roughly $3.55B expected. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance rose to $13.0–13.3B.

takeaways.label: Backlog keeps growing
takeaways.text: Contracted backlog reached $132.5B, up from about $104B last quarter, reinforcing demand for AI computing capacity.

takeaways.label: Losses and debt
takeaways.text: Net loss was $709M, with interest costs of $846M in the quarter and about $47B of debt. Analysts flagged financing as the main risk.

reports.verdict: Trump Media's $410 million profit came from bitcoin gains, not its business, which still earned about $3 million in revenue and an operating loss.

takeaways.label: Profit is crypto gains
takeaways.text: Net income was $409.7 million versus a $54.8 million loss a year ago. About $378 million came from digital-asset gains, with an adjusted EBITDA loss near $12 million.

takeaways.label: Media business still tiny
takeaways.text: Revenue was about $3.0 million, up 205% from roughly $1.0 million, driven mainly by Truth API subscriptions. Legal fees fell to $2.4 million from $20.3 million.

takeaways.label: Bitcoin-heavy balance sheet
takeaways.text: The company held about 15,649 bitcoin at quarter-end and roughly $2.3 billion in financial assets, so results swing with bitcoin's price. The nine-month net loss was about $234 million.

takeaways.label: TAE merger nears
takeaways.text: The fusion-company merger is still expected to close in Q4 2026. The SEC has declared the merger filing (Form S-4) effective; shareholder and regulatory approvals remain.

reports.verdict: Berkshire's core profit slipped as GEICO weakened, but a record $9.6 billion buyback signals management sees its own stock as cheap.

takeaways.label: Buybacks accelerate
takeaways.text: Berkshire repurchased $9.6 billion of its own stock in the quarter, more than double the prior quarter's $4.5 billion, and $14.4 billion so far this year.

takeaways.label: GEICO weakening
takeaways.text: Underwriting profit fell 43% to $1.35 billion. GEICO's claims rose to 76.6% of premiums from 71.5% as it cut prices to win back customers.

takeaways.label: Core profit dips
takeaways.text: Operating earnings fell 5.8% to $12.7 billion. Railroad profit rose 19% to $1.73 billion and manufacturing and utilities also grew, but insurance and lower interest income outweighed them.

takeaways.label: Cash still huge
takeaways.text: Cash was about $357 billion by Reuters' count. Berkshire also spent $6.8 billion on homebuilder Taylor Morrison, and the cash pile has shrunk from $380 billion in March.

reports.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook a second time, and the stock now hinges on LS Power's unsolicited $2.00-a-share buyout proposal.

takeaways.label: Buyout offer
takeaways.text: Majority owner LS Power proposed buying all remaining shares for $2.00 cash on Nov. 2. A special committee is reviewing it, and no decision or deal is certain.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook fell to $375-400M from $400-430M. The adjusted EBITDA loss forecast widened to $15-30M from $5-25M. Stall additions are now guided at 1,075-1,275.

takeaways.label: Charging up, total flat
takeaways.text: Charging revenue grew 29% to $72M, but total revenue slipped 1% to $91.4M as automaker-partner (eXtend) revenue halved. Net loss widened to $49.2M from $28.4M.

takeaways.label: Cash and debt strain
takeaways.text: Cash fell to $98.7M from $151M at year-end while long-term debt rose to about $312M from $204M. Capex after offsets hit $24M, versus $4M a year ago.

reports.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on international COVID sales and raised its 2026 outlook, but the cash jump is mostly borrowed money.

takeaways.label: Big beat, raised outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B against roughly $885M expected, mostly international COVID deals. Full-year growth outlook rose to 15–25% from up to 10%, with net income of $162M.

takeaways.label: Cash boost is borrowed
takeaways.text: Year-end cash outlook jumped to $8.1–8.3B from $4.7–5.2B, helped by $2.6B net from convertible notes. Most Q3 sales were still uncollected, and the nine-month cash burn was $2.7B.

takeaways.label: Cancer vaccine win
takeaways.text: Melanoma vaccine intismeran with Keytruda cut recurrence or death risk 42% in Phase 3. Regulatory filings and launch preparation are underway with Merck.

takeaways.label: Costs falling, flu launch limited
takeaways.text: R&D spending outlook cut to $2.7B from $2.9B. The newly approved flu shot launches only in limited form this season, since approval came after contracting closed.
